


// DidChangeWorkspaceFoldersNotification: The `workspace/didChangeWorkspaceFolders` notification is sent from the client to the server when the workspace\nfolder configuration changes."
func (c *Client) DidChangeWorkspaceFoldersNotification(ctx context.Context, didChangeWorkspaceFolders DidChangeWorkspaceFoldersParams){

		//	"method": "workspace/didChangeWorkspaceFolders",
		//	"messageDirection": "clientToServer",
    c.Send(ctx, "workspace/didChangeWorkspaceFolders", didChangeWorkspaceFolders)
}
